summary.text: Jarred Cannon is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates from District 21, listed with Putnam County. His legislative page lists him as chair of the Investments Committee.

paragraphs.text: Cannon's page gives his birth date as December 23, 1997, and his birthplace as Huntington, West Virginia, and lists a B.A. from West Virginia University.
It lists his occupation as business owner in public relations.
His affiliations include board membership with the Ohio-West Virginia Youth Leadership Association and the Lincoln Legacy Foundation, where he is also fundraising chair.
Cannon also serves on the House's Appropriations, Finance and Government Organization committees.
